name: Peggy — Stories into Blog Rows (Celebrity QDE posts)

parameters.formDescription: Upload the story file as .md (numbered ALL-CAPS headlines, e.g. "## QDE-FC-49 — HEADLINE" or "## 49. HEADLINE", then the pitch). Optional per story: a "BART PERSPECTIVE" section (your own account, used in your paragraph of the caption) and a "RESEARCH" section (your notes and links, used as leads). Each story gets deep web research for primary documents (court records, the document scan, government releases, book notes), an evidence folder in Google Drive with the dossier and downloaded PDFs/images, and a complete new row in QDE_Post_Queue with status blank. Katie marks READY. Results post to Slack #qde-celebrity-post-review. Nothing is published.

values.formSubmittedText: Got it. Deep research takes about 5–10 minutes per story (three run at a time). The rows land in QDE_Post_Queue (status blank), evidence folders in Google Drive, and a summary posts to Slack #qde-celebrity-post-review when the batch is done.
